title: Dormant Trading Account Re-Activation Campaigns
summary: Find out why trading accounts went dormant, fix KYC and access blockers first, and run consent-based, compliance-approved journeys that bring clients back without tips or inducements.

seo.title: Dormant Trading Account Reactivation | VipraTech
seo.description: Automation for brokers to segment dormant accounts by reason, clear KYC and access blockers, and run compliant re-engagement journeys with holdout testing.

problem.intro: Brokers carry many accounts that were opened during an IPO rush or a market rally and then went quiet. Some clients lost interest, but many are blocked: their KYC is on hold at the KRA, a nomination or declaration is pending, two-factor login is locked or the bank account was never verified.

pain_points.title: Blanket campaigns miss the real reason
pain_points.detail: A generic 'come back and trade' message does nothing for a client whose account is blocked by a KYC issue.

pain_points.title: Exchange inactivity rules add steps
pain_points.detail: Accounts flagged as inactive under exchange norms may need verification before they can trade again, and clients often do not know this.

pain_points.title: Conduct risk in growth messaging
pain_points.detail: Messages that hint at easy profits or push derivatives to inexperienced clients create regulatory and reputational risk.

pain_points.title: No proof of what worked
pain_points.detail: Without control groups, teams cannot tell whether a campaign brought clients back or simply reached those who would have returned anyway.

solution.overview: We build a reactivation system on top of your back office, KYC data and marketing tools. It segments dormant accounts by likely reason: KYC or KRA status on hold, pending nomination or declarations, locked login, never funded, traded once then stopped, or long-term investor with no recent activity. Blocked accounts get a service-first journey with a re-KYC or update link and help to clear the issue. Others receive approved educational and product-feature content through WhatsApp, email or SMS, with frequency caps and opt-outs. High-value clients and anyone who replies are routed to an RM or support. Every journey runs against a holdout group, so you can see what actually changed.
capabilities: Segments dormant accounts by reason using KYC status, nominee status, login, funding and trade history
Runs service-first journeys for re-KYC, nominee and declaration updates and login recovery
Sends compliance-approved educational and feature content through WhatsApp, email and SMS
Applies consent checks, frequency caps and exclusions for vulnerable segments
Routes high-value clients and replies to RMs or support with context
Measures each journey against a randomly assigned holdout group

workflow.title: Build the dormant list
workflow.detail: Dormant accounts are pulled with KYC, nominee, login, funding and consent status.

workflow.title: Classify the dormancy reason
workflow.detail: Each account is assigned a likely reason using rules and a simple scoring model.

workflow.title: Clear blockers first
workflow.detail: Accounts blocked by KYC or declarations get a service journey with update links and help.

workflow.title: Send approved content
workflow.detail: Other segments receive compliance-approved content within consent and frequency limits.

workflow.title: Route replies and high-value clients
workflow.detail: Replies and high-value accounts go to an RM or support agent with context.

workflow.title: Measure against holdout
workflow.detail: Reactivation steps are compared with a holdout group for each journey.

inputs: Account activity, last trade and funding history
KYC and KRA status, nominee and declaration status
outputs: RM and support task lists with context
human_in_the_loop: Compliance approves every template and content item before use, and RMs or support agents handle every reply and high-value conversation. Marketing owners decide which journeys to scale based on holdout results.
integrations: Marketing automation or customer data platform
WhatsApp Business API, email and DLT-registered SMS gateway
guardrails: No stock tips, return promises or derivatives inducements in any content
Only compliance-approved templates can be sent
Consent checked before every send, and opt-outs honoured immediately
Frequency caps per client and channel
Segments with recent heavy derivatives losses excluded from trading-oriented messages
compliance_notes: Content stays informational and avoids investment advice and inducements, in line with SEBI and exchange expectations on communication with investors.
Messages follow TRAI commercial-communication rules through DLT-registered templates and preference checks, and data use follows the DPDP Act 2023.

pilot.scope: One dormant segment, for example accounts blocked by KYC status plus accounts that were funded but never traded, each with a holdout group.
deliverables: Dormancy reason model and segment report
Orchestration set up in your marketing tools

what_we_measure.how: KYC, nominee and login issues cleared in the journey group compared with the holdout.
Logins, funding and first transactions in the journey group compared with the holdout.
Counts per journey and channel, reviewed weekly.
Dispositions recorded by RMs and support for routed accounts.

faqs.q: Will this push clients into derivatives trading?
faqs.a: No. Journeys focus on clearing account blockers and sharing approved educational and feature content. Trading-oriented messages exclude vulnerable segments, and no content offers tips or promises returns.
WhatsApp, email and SMS by default, with optional calls by your team or a voice agent for service-blocked accounts. Each channel checks consent and preferences before sending.

faqs.q: How do we know the campaigns worked?
faqs.a: Every journey has a randomly assigned holdout group. Results compare the two, so you see the effect of the journey rather than clients who would have returned anyway.

faqs.q: Can it handle accounts flagged inactive by the exchange?
faqs.a: Yes. It identifies those accounts and guides clients through the verification or update steps your process requires before they can trade again.
